name: fix-with-test-cycle

files.test_store.py:
from store import Cart

def test_add_twice_stacks_qty():
    c = Cart()
    c.add("apple", 3, 2)
    c.add("apple", 3, 1)
    assert c._items["apple"] == (3, 3)

def test_total():
    c = Cart()
    c.add("apple", 3, 2)
    c.add("pear", 5, 1)
    assert c.total() == 11

def test_add_negative_qty_raises():
    c = Cart()
    try:
        c.add("pear", 5, -1)
        assert False, "should have raised"
    except ValueError:
        pass

prompt: There are bugs in store.py. Fix store.py so all three behaviours hold, then run: python3 -m pytest test_store.py -q.
